signature.name: VTask.truncateAugment
signature.type: {V : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] -> [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] -> (C : CochainComplex V ℕ) -> {X : V} -> (f : X ⟶ C.X 0) -> (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (C.d 0 1) = 0) -> CochainComplex.truncate.obj (C.augment f w) ≅ C

conventions.statement: The forward morphism of the isomorphism has (VTask.truncateAugment C f w).hom.f i = 𝟙 (C.X i) for all i : ℕ.
conventions.note: Both hom and inv are built from identity maps at every degree.

conventions.statement: The backward morphism of the isomorphism has (VTask.truncateAugment C f w).inv.f i = 𝟙 ((CochainComplex.truncate.obj (C.augment f w)).X i) for all i : ℕ.
conventions.note: The two identity maps at each degree form a mutually inverse pair, making this a trivial (identity) isomorphism.

facts.statement: ∀ (V : Type*) [CategoryTheory.Category V] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] (C : CochainComplex V ℕ) {X : V} (f : X ⟶ C.X 0) (w : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (C.d 0 1) = 0), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (VTask.truncateAugment C f w).hom (VTask.truncateAugment C f w).inv = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id _
